scenario: LUNI.8.6 — a `let` annotation never drops a unit. `let f: Float = r.temp` on a celsius slot would leave `f` holding the kelvin base value (LUNI.7.2) with no conversion written, so the unitless annotation on a unit-carrying value is DS_VALIDATE_LET_DIM_MISMATCH; `r.temp::Float` is the strip. Drives `dsc.validate.luni_8_6_annotation`'s dimension arm with a dimensionless annotation (no `implicit` formula exists, so no bridge applies).
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Reading scope logical:
    temp: celsius key

rule strip:
    Reading r
->
    let f: Float = r.temp
    log info "raw float {f}"
